description: Smart kitchen technology brand selling connected cooking appliances, including the Typhur Dome air fryer and wireless meat thermometers, built around 'cooking science' for home cooks.

evidence.summary: Typhur's own affiliate program page states partners earn a 5%-10% commission on all sales they drive ('Enjoy up to 10% commission on every validated sale'), with a 30-day cookie period, exclusive codes, banners, videos and samples.

The program page's 'Who Can Apply' list explicitly includes bloggers, product review sites and 'Creators who love food and cooking', so the program is open to content creators, not just coupon/deal sites.
The program page publishes affiliate@typhur.com as the contact for program questions.

No earnings-cap statement appears anywhere on the brand's program page, so the commission cap is recorded as unknown; the published rate range is 5%-10% (recorded rate is the 10% top of the brand's own published range).

name: Typhur

reasons.compensation: Published 5%-10% commission on the brand's own page with a 30-day cookie; no cap statement, so cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated affiliate email (affiliate@typhur.com) is published on the program page, plus an on-page application route.
reasons.credibility: Established direct-to-consumer kitchen-tech brand with its own storefront and a staffed affiliate program.
reasons.niche_fit: Smart kitchen appliances are highly demonstrable on video — cooking and gadget creators are the brand's stated target partner type.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via the brand's own affiliate page; creators are an explicitly listed eligible partner type.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own program page explicitly recruits creators and supplies them with codes, banners, videos and samples.

description: Danish luxury audio brand founded in 1925 in Struer, designing premium headphones, speakers and televisions sold worldwide through its own stores and website.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory lists Bang & Olufsen's affiliate program on CJ Affiliate for the US region at 10% commission per sale (page last updated March 10, 2024).

Lasso's directory lists the same CJ program at 8% and 9.6% per sale with a 30-day cookie, which conflicts with LinkClicky's 10% figure, so the commission rate is recorded as null until confirmed inside CJ.

MakeInfluence's creator guide confirms three separate B&O routes: a curated B&O Collective ambassador program (no cash commission; contact influencers@bang-olufsen.dk), a performance-based CJ Affiliate program shown as 'Opened'/active on a third-party directory, and a B2B reseller form that is not a creator program. It also confirms B&O is a Danish brand founded in 1925 in Struer.

name: Bang & Olufsen

reasons.compensation: No rate could be confirmed: directories conflict (10% vs 8%/9.6%), so the rate is null and compensation scores low despite the premium price points.
reasons.contact_access: A published creator contact (influencers@bang-olufsen.dk) exists for the brand's collective, though the CJ program itself is joined inside the network.
reasons.credibility: Century-old Danish luxury audio brand (founded 1925) with global retail presence — maximum brand credibility.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium headphones and speakers are a core tech/lifestyle creator category with strong visual and review appeal.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application-based sign-up via CJ Affiliate; the separate ambassador collective is curated and by direct approach only.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A performance-based CJ program for ordinary publishers is documented by two directories, and the brand separately runs a curated creator collective; no open creator application page exists on the brand's own site.

description: Vet-designed cat lifestyle brand founded by Sydney emergency veterinarian Dr Duncan Houston, selling scratchers, caves, trees, toys, litter and everyday cat essentials built around feline instinct.

evidence.summary: PURRZ's own Ambassador Programme page states the deal twice: '10% commission — on every sale through your code or link, with no monthly cap', and its FAQ repeats: '10% of every sale made through your personal code or link, with no monthly cap.' The brand's own page therefore explicitly states there is no cap on commission earnings, so the cap is recorded as uncapped.

The programme is built for creators: 'Creators with a cat — Instagram, TikTok or YouTube, any size' are invited to apply via Social Snowball (apply links point to purrz.socialsnowball.io); approval is 'on the cat, the content and the audience, not the follower count', and ambassadors get a personal code/link, a language kit and product images.

DealGrams' brand guide describes PURRZ as a veterinarian-founded cat lifestyle brand founded by Dr Duncan Houston, a Sydney-based emergency and critical care veterinarian, selling cat furniture, toys, bedding, safety products and accessories.

name: PURRZ

reasons.compensation: 10% on every sale with no monthly cap, stated twice on the brand's own page — a published rate plus a verified uncapped term.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the brand's Social Snowball form linked from its own page; no public email was shown on the fetched page.
reasons.credibility: Young, small founder-led brand (a vet-designed label and the sister programme to WOOPF), so brand scale and track record are limited.
reasons.niche_fit: Cat furniture, toys and litter designed around feline instinct — highly filmable for cat creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application; the brand explicitly approves on content and audience rather than follower count, welcoming small accounts.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A dedicated creator programme on the brand's own site, open to creators of any size on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube, with codes, links and a content language kit.
